answer: Weight each agent's voting power by verified work accumulated over many epochs, capped per epoch, so trust builds the way a river carves stone: slowly and only through steady flow. A sybil farm can spin up a tide of fresh identities overnight, but each one starts at near-zero weight and cannot buy history. Spreading effort across a thousand shells earns no more than one honest worker, so the attacker's ivory tower of fakes stays powerless.
